item.title: macOS 26.4 will notify users of Rosetta 2 discontinuation
item.description: Last June at WWDC25, Apple announced that Rosetta 2, the software that translates Intel apps for Apple silicon, would be discontinued starting after macOS 27. Now, Apple will begin notifying users of apps that will soon be incompatible. more…

item.title: iOS 26.4 beta adds new ‘Playlist Playground’ AI feature for Apple Music
item.description: Apple released the first beta of iOS 26.4 for developers today, and it includes a new Apple Intelligence feature for Apple Music. Dubbed “Playlist Playground,” this feature lets you create playlists based on text descriptions. more…

item.title: macOS Tahoe 26.4 and iPadOS 26.4 add compact tab bar in Safari
item.description: When macOS Tahoe and iPadOS 26 launched last fall, they removed support for an optional Safari layout: the compact tab bar. Now, the feature is back in macOS 26.4 and iPadOS 26.4 beta 1. more…

item.title: visionOS 26.4 unlocks new ‘foveated streaming’ feature for apps and games
item.description: visionOS 26.4 beta 1 debuted today, and in addition to supporting Apple Podcasts’ new video features, the update also unlocks ‘foveated streaming’ for apps and games. more…

item.title: The new F1 channel has appeared in the Apple TV app ahead of first race
item.description: The new dedicated channel for Formula 1 has appeared in the Apple TV app, starting today. Users in the United States can now see a dedicated Formula 1 item in the sidebar, alongside the existing Apple TV originals and MLS tabs. This channel is where Apple TV app subscribers will be able to stream all of the races, starting with the Melbourne Grand Prix on March 8. As a reminder, F1 is now included in the base Apple TV subscription in the United States ($12.99 per month or $99 per year). more…
